import json, random, subprocess, sys
MAIN="/work/submission/main.py"

def is_int(x): return type(x) is int

def validate_out(o, n):
    assert isinstance(o, dict), "root"
    assert set(o.keys())=={"rounds","metrics","classes","summary"}, set(o.keys())
    R=o["rounds"]; assert isinstance(R,list)
    for i,r in enumerate(R):
        assert set(r.keys())=={"id","started","source_final_us","source_complete","host_delivery_us","source_proof"}, r.keys()
        assert r["id"]==i
        assert isinstance(r["started"],bool)
        assert r["source_final_us"] is None or is_int(r["source_final_us"])
        assert r["source_complete"] is None or isinstance(r["source_complete"],bool)
        assert r["host_delivery_us"] is None or is_int(r["host_delivery_us"])
        assert isinstance(r["source_proof"],list) and all(is_int(x) for x in r["source_proof"])
        assert r["source_proof"]==sorted(set(r["source_proof"]))
        if not r["started"]:
            assert r["source_final_us"] is None and r["source_complete"] is None
            assert r["host_delivery_us"] is None and r["source_proof"]==[]
        if r["host_delivery_us"] is None:
            assert not r["started"] or True
    M=o["metrics"]
    assert set(M.keys())=={"host_probe_tx","network_ping_tx","network_ack_tx","host_ack_tx",
        "deduplicated_ping","capacity_drops","late_ping","ignored_ack","allocations",
        "cache_peak","peak_entries","end_us"}, set(M.keys())
    for k in M:
        if k=="cache_peak":
            assert isinstance(M[k],list) and len(M[k])==n and all(is_int(x) and x>=0 for x in M[k])
        else:
            assert is_int(M[k]) and M[k]>=0, (k,M[k])
    C=o["classes"]; assert isinstance(C,list)
    sigs=[]
    for c in C:
        assert set(c.keys())=={"signature","candidate_count","evidence_rounds","state","candidate_witnesses"}, c.keys()
        assert isinstance(c["signature"],list) and all(isinstance(x,str) for x in c["signature"])
        assert is_int(c["candidate_count"]) and c["candidate_count"]>=1
        assert isinstance(c["evidence_rounds"],list) and all(is_int(x) for x in c["evidence_rounds"])
        assert c["evidence_rounds"]==sorted(set(c["evidence_rounds"]))
        assert c["state"] in ("unobserved","unique","ambiguous")
        assert isinstance(c["candidate_witnesses"],list)
        if c["candidate_count"]==1:
            assert len(c["candidate_witnesses"])==1
            assert c["state"]==("unique" if c["evidence_rounds"] else "unobserved")
        else:
            assert len(c["candidate_witnesses"])==2
            assert c["candidate_witnesses"][0]!=c["candidate_witnesses"][1]
            assert c["state"]==("ambiguous" if c["evidence_rounds"] else "unobserved")
        for w in c["candidate_witnesses"]:
            assert isinstance(w,list) and all(is_int(x) for x in w)
        sigs.append(tuple(c["signature"]))
    assert sigs==sorted(sigs), "classes not sorted"
    assert len(set(sigs))==len(sigs), "dup signatures"
    S=o["summary"]
    assert set(S.keys())=={"topology_paths","observable_classes","observed_classes",
        "unique_observed_classes","ambiguous_observed_classes","path_evidence_lower",
        "path_evidence_upper","coverage_status"}, set(S.keys())
    for k in S:
        if k!="coverage_status": assert is_int(S[k]) and S[k]>=0, k
    assert S["coverage_status"] in ("no-routes","no-evidence","complete","partial")
    # consistency
    obs=[c for c in C if c["evidence_rounds"]]
    assert S["observable_classes"]==len(C)
    assert S["observed_classes"]==len(obs)
    assert S["unique_observed_classes"]==sum(1 for c in C if c["state"]=="unique")
    assert S["ambiguous_observed_classes"]==sum(1 for c in C if c["state"]=="ambiguous")
    assert S["path_evidence_lower"]==len(obs)
    assert S["path_evidence_upper"]==sum(c["candidate_count"] for c in obs)
    assert S["topology_paths"]==sum(c["candidate_count"] for c in C)
    assert M["host_probe_tx"]==len(R)
    assert M["host_ack_tx"]==sum(1 for r in R if r["source_final_us"] is not None)
    assert M["allocations"]>=M["host_ack_tx"]
    if len(C)==0: assert S["coverage_status"]=="no-routes"
    elif len(obs)==0: assert S["coverage_status"]=="no-evidence"
    elif len(obs)==len(C): assert S["coverage_status"]=="complete"
    else: assert S["coverage_status"]=="partial"
    # delivered rounds must be exactly those with host_delivery_us not None
    return True

def gen(rng):
    n = rng.randint(2, 10)
    pairs = [(u,v) for u in range(n) for v in range(u+1,n)]
    rng.shuffle(pairs)
    ne = rng.randint(0, min(384, n*(n-1)//2))
    pairs = pairs[:ne]
    edges = [{"u":u,"v":v,"ping_us":rng.randint(1,8),"ack_us":rng.randint(1,8),
              "label":rng.choice(["a","b","c"])} for (u,v) in pairs]
    rounds=[]
    for _ in range(rng.randint(0,8)):
        rounds.append({"launch_us":rng.choice([0,0,1,2,5,20]),"timeout_us":rng.randint(1,60),
            "host_delay_us":rng.randint(1,10),"drop_host_ack":rng.random()<0.25,
            "drop_ping":rng.sample(range(len(edges)),rng.randint(0,min(3,len(edges)))) if edges else [],
            "drop_ack":rng.sample(range(len(edges)),rng.randint(0,min(3,len(edges)))) if edges else []})
    return {"version":1,"n":n,"capacity":[rng.choice([0,1,2,48]) for _ in range(n)],"edges":edges,"rounds":rounds}

bad=0
for it in range(600):
    rng=random.Random(987654+it)
    doc=gen(rng)
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I",MAIN],input=json.dumps(doc).encode(),capture_output=True)
    if p.returncode!=0:
        print("nonzero", p.returncode, p.stdout[:100]); bad+=1; continue
    try:
        validate_out(json.loads(p.stdout), doc["n"])
    except AssertionError as e:
        print("SCHEMA FAIL iter",it,e); print(json.dumps(doc)); bad+=1
print("schema check done, failures:", bad)
PYEOF
cd /work && python3 /work/tmp/tests/schema_check.py
